purpose: Teach: 変態/下痢/淘汰/封鎖/犯す/駆除/悟り/生ずる

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、変態反応を示す患者さんを医療チームで丁寧に診ます
lines.en: Ren — we handle patients with allergic reactions with careful attention from the whole medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady professional tone. Slight emphasis on 'careful'—this matters to her. Unhurried delivery. The composure of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、下痢の患者さんに脱水対策を医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes — for patients with diarrhea, we implement dehydration management as a team across the hospital.
lines.style: Same steady baseline. A touch more concrete now, moving into the practical. Still calm. The kind of reassurance that comes from having done this many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療資源の淘汰を、貴院、見ておられますね、先生
lines.en: I see your hospital pays close attention to how medical resources are allocated, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Slightly tentative—he's testing whether this question is appropriate. Soft rise at the end. The politeness of someone still figuring out how the room works.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染拡大時の病棟封鎖を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes — we prepare our ward closure protocols for infection control situations across the medical team.
lines.style: Unchanged rhythm. Professional clarity. She's answering his observation with equal clarity. No defensiveness, just fact. Still measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療ミスを犯す医師の処分を、貴院、厳しく対応されておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital takes quite a strict approach to how you handle physician errors, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Slower now, more deliberate. He's thinking as he speaks. Respectful but probing deeper. The slight hesitation of someone asking something he knows matters. Eye contact implicit in the tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、院内のゴキブリ駆除を業者と連携して進めます
lines.en: Yes — we partner with pest control vendors to manage in-hospital pest issues as part of our ongoing operations.
lines.style: Back to steady. No change in register—she treats every answer with equal weight. Professional, complete. The kind of doctor who answers every question as if it deserves the same care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 終末期医療の悟りに、貴院、医療チームで寄り添われますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital walks alongside patients in end-of-life care with real compassion from the medical team, don't you?
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. He's moved to something that touches him. Slower pace. Respect in every word. The slight tremor of someone asking about something real.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬の副作用から生ずる症状を医療チームで丁寧に診ます
lines.en: Yes — we carefully assess and manage symptoms that arise from medication side effects as a coordinated team.
lines.style: Warm close. Slight softening in her tone now, matching the depth of his last question. Still professional but noticeably present. The care in her voice matches the care she's describing.
